symbols.source_description:
[Markings](https://palantir.com/docs/foundry/security/markings/) provide an additional level of access control for files,
folders, and Projects within Foundry. Markings define eligibility criteria that restrict visibility
and actions to users who meet those criteria. To access a resource, a user must be a member of all
Markings applied to a resource to access it.
symbols.local_summary: A Marking restricts access to a file, folder or Project. `marking_id` identifies it; `is_directly_applied` distinguishes a direct marking from an inherited one. A user must satisfy every marking on the resource to access it.

symbols.rationale: Summary now states one membership, possible guest memberships, Project access rule, and inheritance through file hierarchy and direct dependencies. Fields remain correct.

symbols.source_description:
[Organizations](https://palantir.com/docs/foundry/security/orgs-and-spaces/#organizations) are access requirements applied to
Projects that enforce strict silos between groups of users and resources. Every user is a member of only
one Organization, but can be a guest member of multiple Organizations. In order to meet access requirements,
users must be a member or guest member of at least one Organization applied to a Project.
Organizations are inherited via the file hierarchy and direct dependencies.
symbols.local_summary: An Organization is an access requirement on a Project. Each user belongs to one Organization and may be a guest member of several. To meet a Project's access requirements, the user must belong to or be a guest member of at least one Organization applied to that Project. Organizations are inherited through the file hierarchy and direct dependencies. `organization_rid` identifies the Organization; `is_directly_applied` records direct application.
